title: Morning priorities — Marisa
content:
Date: 2026-03-13
Quick context: 10am with CEO + CFO. Need concise asks and data. This doc = scratchpad for what to say, who to ping after, and what to take offline.

Top-3 this week (as I see it)
1) Dedicated capacity SLA revisions — finalize wording and pricing tiers (ask: Tim)
   - Why: several mid-market prospects negotiating variance on latency SLOs
   - Risk: too permissive SLA increases support burden; too strict reduces sales flexibility
   - Metric to show: p50/p95 latency by model class (open models vs verified), current 99.9% uptime across Dedicated pools
   - Slides: bring one slide with 3 bullets + table (cost delta by tier)
2) Private deployment onboarding checklist — reduce ramp from 6w -> 3w (ask: Priya)
   - Key moves: standardized network blueprint, KMS integration template, preflight infra checklist
   - Quick wins: publish sample Terraform module + default quantization profile for customer infra
   - Customer story: Acme Inc. P1 to illustrate timeline (incident notes below)
3) Cost optimization pilot (Optimize) — commit to 2 customers for A/B test of batching + quantization recommendations (ask: Samir)
   - Metric: target 20–30% token cost reduction with <2% quality regression on eval set

10am meeting prep (CEO/CFO) — 8 bullet script
- Start: 60s recap of product state (hosted growth + Dedicated traction; highlight one big win: PharmaCo Dedicated deal closed)
- Ask 1 (CFO): Approve phased price tiers for Dedicated and margin floor; show cost sensitivity table
- Ask 2 (CEO): Greenlight two hires for customer onboarding (1 infra PMC, 1 solutions eng) — plan to reallocate budget vs hiring freeze
- Risk to call out: Support cost ramp if SLA tightened; mitigation = onboarding playbook + automation
- Data to show: weekly active customers on Dedicated, avg monthly committed GPU hours, churn signals (2 prospects delayed by security review)
- Close: propose pilot timeline for Optimize (6 weeks), quick update cadence

Meeting notes to capture live (placeholders)
- CFO question: what’s margin at 70% utilization? (follow-up: ask Ops for cost model by EOD)
- CEO asks for a customer quote for marketing — get Ops to redact and send

Customer incident: Acme Inc. (last week) — quick log
- Symptom: elevated tail latency on long context generation (8k+ tokens)
- Root cause (tentative): KV cache spillover during autoscaling plus older kernel fallback path in pool-3
- Immediate mitigation taken: fallback to smaller model + increased burst cap; ticket RED-3412
- Follow-ups: deliver a postmortem (owner: Samir), create automated test to reproduce (owner: infra-oncall)

People to ping after 10am
- Tim O'Leary — finalize SLA wording (Slack @tim / PRD link)
- Priya Iyer — OK to publish onboarding sprint plan (confluence draft link)
- Samir Patel — confirm Optimize pilot customers and measurement plan
- Legal: ask for NDA clause tweak for Dedicated pilots (J.Santos)

Decisions needed by EOD
- Approve price tier framework (CFO)
- Approve immediate headcount reallocation to onboarding (CEO)

Parking lot / Not today
- New marketplace listing cadence (lower priority)
- Region expansion to APAC edge nodes (needs ops roadmap)

Notes to self (quick tasks)
- Write 3 bullet talking points for Tim before 9:30 (email)
- Drop RED-3412 into postmortem template and assign owners
- 2pm sync with Priya: bring draft onboarding checklist and Terraform example

Open questions / unresolved
- How aggressive do we want default quantization on Dedicated? (quality vs cost tradeoff)
- Do we require a minimum committed term for reduced SLA pricing?

End-of-day deliverables (my commitments)
- Send 1-pg summary to execs with 3 asks + 1-slide appendix (due 5pm)
- Confirm pilot customers list with Samir (due EOD)
- Kickoff postmortem for Acme (target first draft tomorrow)

Freeform notes / brain dump
- Consider a short video walkthrough of Private onboarding for CSMs — faster than doc? 10–12m
- Could reuse part of onboarding checklist as a customer-facing "what to expect" one-pager
- If CFO pushes back on hiring, propose contractor for infra PMC 8–12w to bridge gap

End.
